items.headline: Greed cools to 81 and regime returns to Correction while Valuation stays extreme
items.summary: The live AGCI engine reads Greed 81/100, down 6 points daily, Valuation 85/100, Correction regime and EUPHORIA_RISK / Capital preservation — Do not chase.
items.whyItMatters: Sentiment has cooled, but valuation has not reset. AGCI treats the shift as improved optionality rather than a broad buy signal, preserving liquidity and staged entries.
items.agciSignal: GREED COOLING / VALUATION STILL EXTREME / CORRECTION

items.newsletter: This Week's Magazine — The Death of the Safe Haven / 5 Sep 2026
items.headline: Treasury yields above prior-cycle norms challenge the traditional safe-haven role of long bonds
items.summary: Barron's new weekly magazine focuses on portfolio risk created by rising Treasury yields. After the strong August jobs report, the 2-year yield rose near 4.37% and the 10-year near 4.78%, while markets priced a material chance of a September Fed hike.
items.whyItMatters: High long-end duration remains a source of mark-to-market risk even when Treasury credit quality is unquestioned. AGCI keeps duration staggered and favors flexibility over a concentrated long-bond bet.
items.agciSignal: LONG-DURATION RISK / STAGGER DURATION / KEEP DRY POWDER

items.newsletter: Kharg Island / Iran energy infrastructure / 5 Sep 2026
items.headline: Iranian tanker reportedly hit near Kharg Island, raising risk to a critical export hub
items.summary: Iran's Tasnim news agency reported that an Iranian tanker near Kharg Island was struck by four U.S. missiles. No casualties were reported; U.S. military confirmation was not immediately available.
items.whyItMatters: Kharg historically handles the bulk of Iranian crude exports. A verified expansion of strikes toward export infrastructure would raise the probability of a more persistent oil-supply shock, but AGCI distinguishes the Iranian report from independently confirmed U.S. attribution.
items.agciSignal: ESCALATION RISK / CONFIRM ATTRIBUTION / KEEP MODERATE ENERGY HEDGE

items.headline: Foxconn expects third quarter to beat market expectations as AI server demand remains strong
items.category: AI / Technology / Supply Chain / Capital Allocation
items.summary: Foxconn said third-quarter performance should exceed market expectations, citing AI-product demand and record August revenue of T$921.8 billion, up about 52% year over year.
items.whyItMatters: The signal supports continued physical demand for AI servers beyond semiconductor guidance. AGCI still requires funded demand, power availability, margin and cash conversion before extrapolating the cycle.
items.agciSignal: AI SERVER DEMAND CONFIRMED / FUNDING AND POWER STILL MATTER

items.headline: TCS-linked consortium plans up to $7.4 billion for a 1-GW AI data-center campus in India
items.category: AI Infrastructure / Power / Real Assets / Business
items.summary: A Tata Consultancy Services subsidiary and partners announced plans to invest up to 700 billion rupees, about $7.4 billion, in a 1-gigawatt AI data-center campus in Telangana.
items.whyItMatters: AI infrastructure demand is broadening geographically. AGCI treats announced gigawatts as pipeline rather than realized value until power, customers, financing and utilization are contractually visible.
items.agciSignal: GLOBAL AI INFRA EXPANSION / VERIFY POWER + CUSTOMERS + FINANCING
